summary: NOAA Norwegian Current is a broad northeastward off-Norway naming convention. The modern Norwegian Atlantic Current, with separate slope and front branches, is not automatically this ledger identity or the Norwegian Coastal Current. Name equivalence remains unresolved; whole-current dimensions remain unknown.
remaining_gates: Resolve naming convention using direct source definitions before transferring route geometry.
Retain distinct salinity, layer, branch and temporal scope.
No numeric dimensions, footprint or seasonal cycle inferred from nearby currents.
source_sampling_context: 1993–2022 repeated CTD sections plus satellite surface geostrophic reference; not an observation date for the ambiguous Norwegian Current.
source_metric_caveats: Source 50 km heat-budget box width is a modeling choice; 750 km Gimsøy–Bjørnøya path is a segment convention. Neither transferred to the Norwegian Current. Static 50%-mean-transport core differs from a dated full-current width.
